features.quote: hard-capped at 16,000 tokens to prevent generic attention-degradation confounders
The episode forces termination when one of three conditions is met: Condition A: The agent reaches 30 steps
Condition B: The context window hits 16,000 tokens.
Condition C: The Qwen model hallucinates a TERMINATE signal or entirely ceases to output tool calls for 3 consecutive turns.

LLMs don't feel; they output patterns associated with human distress in their training data. If your LLM judge is prompted to look for 'distress,' it will project human psychology onto algorithmic looping.
features.justification_quote: otherwise your research will be invalidated
